reply.text: That's a build, not something I'll sketch in words — sounds like you want a program geared toward job-ready strength and conditioning: full-body strength, grip and carries, and work capacity under fatigue. Tell me what equipment you've got and any days you can't train, and I'll get it built. Anything specific to avoid — bad knees, shoulders, whatever the job's beat up — let me know and I'll build around it.
